title: 003 玄阴聚兽004 陆蓉波
content_zh:
：管明晦操控两根三转黑眚丝再次深入岩石，向上突破。
每上升一尺，长眉真人的神符威力就增加一倍，勉强又延伸了数丈，再次到了即将溃散的边缘！
到底还是不能透出地表，接触到月光……
他有些气馁，不死心地又令黑眚丝横着往别处探查。
镇压神符形成的结界是个球形，上下四面全都没有半分空隙可钻，黑眚丝所过之处，除了岩石土壤，只找到几缕稀疏的树根。
正无可奈何之际，他突然灵光一现：镇压神符蕴含正阳之气，克制我的玄阴道法，却不会克制树木根系，可以用黑眚丝连通树根，以上面的树为媒介吸收月光！
他赶忙操控黑眚丝，各自锁定一条粗根，先运转玄阴大法，将玄阴真气灌注进去。
那是一株五百年的老杨树，树干有十人合抱那么粗，树冠如巨伞，参天直立，虽然还没有生出自己的意识，但也有些灵性，树根长年猛往下扎，想要汲取大地营养。
来自地心的玄阴真气正是它所渴望的，丝丝精气沿着根系脉络进入树干，再沿着枝条延伸到每一片叶子，瞬息间，每片叶子都支楞起来。
老杨叶片比人手掌还大，风一吹过，树叶互相击打，发出“啪啪”
的声音，夜深人静的时候，让人毛骨悚然，民间谓之“鬼拍手”
前不栽桑，后不栽柳，院中不栽鬼拍手，说的就是这玩意。
随着一阵哗啦啦的树叶响，千万根枝条齐刷刷地拧转，叶片纷纷扬起四十五度，正对向天上的那轮圆月。
月光如雨，这些叶片则似千万只手掌，努力而又小心地承托起如水般荡漾的银波。
这太阴精华被吸收进树体，直达根部，再由黑眚丝输送到管明晦的身体里面。
月华入体，浑身清凉！
这种清凉，跟从地肺里阴风来的刺骨阴寒不同，神魂更像是沐浴在灵泉之中，让人浑身舒坦，感觉整个世界都变得美好起来！
管明晦按照真经所述，将从月华中采炼的天之玄气与先前得到的地之玄气结合。
天者应乾卦，地者应坤卦，二者由他意志操控，在体内相遇，相互磨擦激荡，乾坤交媾，阴阳相索。
一索生震卦、巽卦。

震卦应雷，巽卦应风，死气沉沉的枯朽肉身之中开始风雷激荡，焕发生机。
二索生坎卦，离卦。
坎卦应水，在身为肾。
肾气为周身万气本源，此气一出，先是肾脏如枯木逢春般生发出一股股肾气，顺着经络游走全身，滋养筋肉脏腑。
离卦应火，在人身为心。
肾气生发的同时，也生出了一股股的心气。
躯体的心脏已经被七修剑刺碎成了八瓣，比较难以恢复。
但有了心气，既能让心脏快速愈合，也能心肾相息，反养元神。
这可比单纯用地气温养效果好得多，身体能够加速愈合，时间能缩短十之八九！
管明晦大叫天无绝人之路：老子来这里重活一次，穿越到这谷辰这等凶人身上，又受了这么多苦，不是在这里等着李英琼来砍，给峨眉弟子当经验包的！
老子要修成最凶最狠的神通法术，敢惹老子，就拿你们当怪物刷！
接下来的每天晚上，月亮出现以后，他都争分夺秒，努力采集更多的月华精气。
等到白天，他在忍受着烈风煅体的同时，将天地玄阴二气调和交媾，反补形神。
随着肉身一点点恢复，元神跟着逐渐强大，他能施展出来的法术也越来越厉害。
他通过那株老杨树释放玄阴之气，让附近的花草树木疯狂生长，再从中挑选四十九株老树，都有数百年的树龄，促使它们把根系快速向下延伸，扎到黑眚丝能够到的地方，接着再用黑眚丝把老树根脉与自己连在一起。
经过玄阴真气反复洗礼，这些树渐渐成了他意志的延伸，不止能帮他吸收月光，还能让他“看”
到外面的世界，只是依旧没有什么颜色，如在梦境之中。
content_en:
: Guan Minghui controlled two three-turn black silk threads to penetrate deep into the rock again and break through upward.
With each foot raised, the power of Changmei Zhenren's magical talisman doubled, and it barely extended for several more feet, reaching the edge of collapse again!
After all, it still cannot penetrate the surface of the earth and come into contact with the moonlight...
He was a little discouraged, but he refused to give up and ordered Black Eyes to explore elsewhere.
The barrier formed by the suppression talisman was spherical, with no gaps at all on the top and bottom sides to drill through. Wherever the black silk passed, apart from rocky soil, only a few sparse tree roots were found.
When he was helpless, he suddenly had an idea: The Suppression Talisman contains the energy of Zhengyang. It can restrain my Mysterious Vagina method, but it will not restrain the roots of trees. You can use black silk to connect the roots of the trees, and use the trees above as a medium to absorb the moonlight!
He hurriedly controlled the black silk threads, each locked on a thick root, and first used the Xuanyin Dafa to pour Xuanyin's true energy into it.
It was a five-hundred-year-old poplar tree. The trunk was as thick as ten people hugging each other. The crown of the tree was like a giant umbrella, towering and upright. Although it had not yet developed its own consciousness, it still had some spirituality. The roots of the tree had been digging down for many years, trying to absorb the nutrients of the earth.
The Xuanyin true energy from the center of the earth is exactly what it desires. Silks of essence enter the tree trunk along the root veins, and then extend along the branches to every leaf. In an instant, every leaf becomes stiff.
The leaves of the old poplar are bigger than a human hand. When the wind blows, the leaves hit each other and make a "pop" sound.
The sound is so creepy in the dead of night that it is called "ghost clapping" among the people.
Don’t plant mulberries in front, don’t plant willows in the back, don’t plant ghosts in the courtyard and clap your hands, that’s what they say.
With a rustle of leaves, thousands of branches twisted in unison, and the leaves were raised at 45 degrees, facing the full moon in the sky.
The moonlight is like rain, and these leaves are like thousands of palms, working hard and carefully to support the rippling silver waves like water.
This Taiyin essence is absorbed into the tree body, reaches the roots, and is then transported to Guan Minghui's body through the black silk thread.
The moonlight enters the body and feels cool all over!
This kind of coolness is different from the biting coldness that comes from the cold wind in the earth's lungs. The soul is more like bathing in a spiritual spring, which makes people feel comfortable all over and makes the whole world feel better!
Guan Minghui combined the profound energy of heaven extracted from the moonlight with the profound energy of earth obtained previously according to the scriptures.
Heaven corresponds to the Qian hexagram, and earth corresponds to the Kun hexagram. The two are controlled by his will. They meet in the body, friction and excitement with each other, Qian and Kun intercourse, and Yin and Yang are intertwined.
One rope generates Zhen Gua and Xun Gua.
The Zhen hexagram responds to thunder, and the Xun hexagram responds to wind. The wind and thunder begin to stir in the dead and decaying body, and it glows with life.
Er Suo Sheng Kan Gua, Li Gua.
The Kan hexagram corresponds to water, which is in the body and kidneys.
Kidney qi is the source of all qi in the whole body. Once this qi comes out, the kidneys first produce streams of kidney qi like a dead tree in spring, traveling along the meridians throughout the body to nourish the muscles, muscles and internal organs.
The Li hexagram corresponds to fire, which is in the human body and mind.
When kidney qi is generated, waves of heart qi are also generated.
The heart of the body has been broken into eight petals by the Seventh Sword, making it difficult to recover.
But with heart qi, the heart can heal quickly, the heart and kidneys can be in harmony, and the soul can be nourished.
This is much more effective than simply using earth temperature to nourish your body. The body can heal faster and the time can be shortened by nine out of ten!
Guan Minghui yelled: "I came here to live a new life, and traveled to such evil people as Gu Chen, and suffered so much. I didn't wait here for Li Yingqiong to kill me, and use it as an experience pack for Emei disciples!"
I want to master the most ferocious magical powers. If you dare to offend me, I will treat you like monsters!
Every night after the moon appeared, he raced against time to collect more moon essence.
During the day, while enduring the strong wind and forging his body, he harmonized the two qi of heaven and earth, xuanyin and yin, and replenished his form and spirit.
As the physical body recovers little by little, the soul gradually becomes stronger, and the spells he can castIt’s getting more and more powerful.
He released the mysterious yin energy through the old poplar tree, causing the nearby flowers and trees to grow wildly. He then selected forty-nine old trees, all hundreds of years old, prompting them to quickly extend their root systems downwards to where the black silk threads could reach, and then used the black silk threads to connect the roots of the old trees to himself.
After repeated baptism of Xuanyin's true energy, these trees gradually became an extension of his will, not only helping him absorb the moonlight, but also allowing him to "see"
When I go to the outside world, there is still no color, just like in a dream.
